name: Oxyphenisatine

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in United States and 18 other countries, first in 1973 — for liver harm

similar.name: Oxyphenisatin Acetate
problems: Pulled from the market in United States and 18 other countries, first in 1970 — for liver harm

summary: Oxyphenisatine was pulled from the market in the United States and 18 other countries, starting in 1973, due to liver harm [3]. A related drug named Oxyphenisatin Acetate was also taken off the market in the United States and 18 other countries starting in 1970 for causing liver harm [3]. Based on a small computer model rather than tests on people, this drug received a medium score for liver harm and a low score for heart harm [M].
